summary: Pull requests from this repository, authored by listed accounts, may use the CI evidence signing key; manual runs on main reach it too

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; CI configuration and one data file only.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Nothing reads the signed notes to skip a check yet; the evidence gate is not on main. The trust input is .st/evidence-authors.json, read from the base commit of each pull request.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Required checks keep their names and outcomes; every signing step is fail-soft and a refusal only means no note is made.

manual.detail: No manual step. Operations should not add reviewers, a wait timer or a branch rule to the evidence-signing environment without telling the owner.

recovery.detail: Narrow the evidence-signing environment to the merge queue and main, or revert this change; notes already signed stay valid and are only accepted through the base-commit key list.
